title: Healthy Roadmap for a Browser Game Launch
author: Objective_You_0
selftext:
Hello everyone! I'm nearing the final stages of developing my first browser game, and I want to ensure I launch the product in the safest and most sustainable way possible, both for me as a developer and for my future users.
I'm particularly interested in leveraging your experience! What would be, in your opinion, an ideal roadmap from the current stage ("almost ready") to the official launch (1.0)?
I'm specifically looking for advice on:
1. Beta Testing (Closed/Open):
• When is the best time to start?
• What are the priority items to test (performance, core gameplay loop, UI/UX)?
• How long should a testing phase ideally last?
2. Security & Infrastructure:
• What are the biggest security risks for a browser game (exploits, cheating, SQL injection, etc.)?
• What are the minimum security measures I must implement before a public launch? (E.g., rate limiting, server-side data validation)
• What kind of server monitoring is crucial early on?
3. Official Launch (Launch Day):
• How do I manage unexpected traffic spikes (scalability)?
• Is there a "healthy" marketing strategy that won't immediately crash my servers? (E.g., phased rollout, starting with a small niche audience)
Any experience, whether related to success or failure, is incredibly valuable! Thank you in advance for any tips or helpful resources! 🙏
TL;DR: Help with a launch & security roadmap for a new browser game!
